title: Building Blocks
description: Mod that adds plenty of new building blocks that you can use to build anything you want.
body:
Building Blocks

CookieCraft Bulding Blocks is all about good looking building blocks, foodstuff and furniture. we are a revolutionary building block mod featuring 3D blocks, double sided walls and all types of things that never feel out of place in a builders palette! enjoy!

features:

- Over 10 new treetypes

- Lot of new bricks and walls

- Over 200 double-sided blocks

- 3 New plants type

- Over 10 new foodstuffs
